استرحمت (form X)
# اِسْتَرْحَمْتُ (istarḥamtu) /is.tar.ħam.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَرْحَمَ (istarḥama)
# اِسْتَرْحَمْتَ (istarḥamta) /is.tar.ħam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَرْحَمَ (istarḥama)
# اِسْتَرْحَمْتِ (istarḥamti) /is.tar.ħam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَرْحَمَ (istarḥama)
# اِسْتَرْحَمَتْ (istarḥamat) /is.t
